learn.title: Repeated multiplying
learn.body: An exponential model has the form $y=a\cdot b^x$. Here $a$ is the starting value and $b$ is the growth factor each step. If $b$ is more than 1 it grows, and if $b$ is between 0 and 1 it decays.

learn.title: A doubling population
learn.body: A colony of 500 doubles every 3 hours, so $P=500\cdot 2^{t/3}$.

learn.title: Logarithms undo exponentials
learn.body: $\log_b(y)$ asks: what power of $b$ gives $y$? So $\log_2 32=5$ because $2^5=32$. When the base is not a neat match, use $\ln$ on both sides: $1.05^t=5$ gives $t=\frac{\ln 5}{\ln 1.05}\approx 33.0$.

learn.title: Decay and half-life
learn.body: A substance with half-life 5 days follows $A=80\cdot\left(\frac12\right)^{t/5}$. After 15 days three halvings have happened: $80\to40\to20\to10$ grams.

questions.prompt: Match each model to what it says.
